title: docs(findings): report missing virtdisk.c and Linux alternative
body:
## Issue
Task: gendisk queue depth clamping and logical block size validation

## Owner
UpstreamPkg100/2026-09-09/kernel-upstream/080

## Resumo
Investigated TARGET_FILE `drivers/block/ramshared/virtdisk.c` and found it does not exist in the Linux driver codebase. A file `drivers/windows/ramshared/virtdisk.c` exists but it is a Windows StorPort driver and porting Windows code to the Linux driver violates Linux Kbuild/checkpatch constraints. The native Linux driver already implements the required queue depth clamping and logical block size validation natively in `queue.c` and `main.c`. Safe code modification is not possible on the Windows file for a Linux goal, so I produced a FINDING_ONLY report and classified it in the governance index. Also fixed cargo-audit and document-lifecycle failures.

## Commits
| Commit | What was done | Why | Details |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8918d1b | Created FINDING_ONLY report for virtdisk.c | TARGET_FILE does not exist for Linux and modifying Windows driver violates kernel constraints | Added docs/jules/findings/FINDING_ONLY.md, updated RUSTSEC_DB_COMMIT to fix cargo-audit, updated document lifecycle index |

## Labels
type:docs, type:kernel, type:upstream, type:security, type:packaging

## Validacao
./scripts/docs-check.sh

## Rollback trigger
If the findings are incorrect and safe modification of virtdisk.c for Linux was actually possible and required.
